initial_files.content:
Designated narrative:
During the Harbor library renovation, staff moved the reading room to the east hall. A leaking roof postponed the opening by three days. Volunteers kept the book collection dry by covering the shelves. The library reopened on Thursday after the repair passed inspection.

Related background narrative:
At the Ridge library, the computer room moved to the west hall during maintenance. A heating fault delayed public access by one day. Staff protected the computers with covers. Regular service resumed on Monday after an electrical inspection.

3.content: During the renovation of the Harbor library, staff relocated the reading room to the east hall. A roof leak delayed the reopening by three days, but volunteers protected the books by draping the shelves. After the repairs cleared inspection, the library reopened on Thursday.
